content:
AAEON claims the PICO-PTH4 is the world’s first 2.5-inch Pico-ITX board powered by an Intel Panther Lake processor, such as the Core Ultra 5 325, Core Ultra 7 355, and Core Ultra X7 358H, delivering up to 180 TOPS of AI performance in a 100mm x 72mm form factor. The single board computer ships with up to 32GB of LPDDR5X, supports M.2 M-Key/E-Key and PCIe x4 FPC expansion, and offers dual 2.5GbE, HDMI 2.1 video output, two USB 3.2 Gen 2 ports, and internal connectors for USB 2.0, front panel, RS-232/422/485, GPIO, and SMBus/I2C. AAEON PICO-PTH4 specifications: Panther Lake SoC (one or the other) Intel Core Ultra 5 325 CPU – Octa-core (4P+4LPE) CPU up to 4.5 GHz with 12MB Smart Cache GPU – 4-core Intel Graphics @ 2.45 GHz (40 TOPS) AI accelerator  – 47 TOPS Intel AI Boost NPU PBP: 25 Watts Core Ultra 7 355 CPU – [...]
